headline: BREAKING (STRAIT_THEATER): SAM AIR DEFENSE INTERCEPT ESCALATES TO DEFCON 1
sub_chyron: Patriot PAC-3 MSE and Iron Beam lasers intercepted 22 incoming hypersonic and cruise missiles over Taipei.
anchor_voice_script: Breaking news from strait_theater. Military sensors confirm Patriot PAC-3 MSE and Iron Beam lasers intercepted 22 incoming hypersonic and cruise missiles over Taipei.. Forces are now at DEFCON 1.
